Syllabus (official contents, last round Advt 08/2021)

The board's suggested contents for the Warder and Matron paper in the 2021 round were:

SectionWhat it coversMarks (approx.)
Languages (English and Punjabi)grammar, synonyms and antonyms, one-word substitution, articles, prepositions, narration, voice, gender and number, idioms, reading comprehension, spellings30
Information technology and computerscomputer and network basics, mobile phones and gadgets, 3G/4G/5G, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, hotspots, malware, GPS, email and messengers, MS Word and spreadsheets25
General knowledge (India and Punjab)current affairs, history, geography, climate, demography, economy and planning, culture, polity, science, sports, cinema and literature, events and leaders of India and Punjab20
Quantitative abilitynumber series, profit and loss, interest, divisibility, ratio and proportion, percentages, data interpretation15
Reasoninglogical thinking, alphanumeric series, odd one out, analogy, common sense, alphabetical arrangement15
Basic law and ConstitutionPreamble, fundamental rights and duties, directive principles, Parliament and law-making, President, Vice-President, PM, state government, Governor, courts, elections and the Election Commission15
Total120 marks, 100 minutes

Since October 2022 every PSSSB paper also carries a qualifying matric-level Punjabi Part A, so expect that in front of this content in the 2026 and later papers. The big lesson from this table: computers alone were 25 marks - more than GK.
